reader.requirement: At COBOL-85, FUNCTION INTEGER of any class-numeric argument-1 (any usage, scaling, sign, literal, expression or numeric-function result) must return the greatest integer less than or equal to it (floor: -1.5 -> -2, +1.5 -> +1).

edition-consulted.switches: the D8 edition window sig.IntroducedIn > ctx.Edition.DialectLevel / RemovedIn (COBOL1502/COBOL1503); the catalog row carries IntroducedIn 85, so --std 85 admits the function

ConstructRegistry numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: at 85 a numeric/integer function written where an identifier stands (MOVE, DISPLAY, ADD operand, PERFORM n TIMES) is COBOL0900 per §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4; inside an arithmetic expression it is not consulted

OPTIONS paragraph (2002) and ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD-DECIMAL (2014) are refused at 85, so the renderer's num.StandardDecimal arm is unreachable and only the native arm runs (the same arm 2023 takes without an OPTIONS paragraph)

reader.edition-search: grep for Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior|ConstructRegistry over IntrinsicRenderer.cs, NumericRenderer.cs, IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs, IntrinsicCarrierRules.cs, FunctionValueLane.cs and src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Intrinsics/*: no hit; the only edition reads on the path are in IntrinsicBinder (window, placement) and the OPTIONS gates in VersionConformancePass
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers -1.5, +1.5, 0, -1.0, +1.0, -0.5, -0.25 on S9V99 items; 18-digit extremes, a negative value one unit in the 17th place, P scaling, packed and binary usage, literal and expression arguments and the binary64 lane (numeric-function argument) are not exercised

reader.notes: CobolIntrinsics.Exact.cs#Floor steps the truncated quotient down by one for a negative argument with a nonzero remainder and multiplies out a negative (P) scale; a numeric-function argument routes to FloorReal (Math.Floor). Every probe gave the floor, including -1E-17 -> -1 and the 18-digit extremes.

refuter.evidence: i6edge.cob at --std 85 (exit 0): INTEGER of SIN(3.14159265358979324) = -1 (true sine is -1.5e-18, so the exact-intake path held the sign; a binary64 pi would give 0), COS(pi18) -> -1, COS(0) -> 1, SIGN LEADING/TRAILING SEPARATE -1.5 -> -2, overpunch -0.1 -> -1, binary -0.01 -> -1, packed -0.5 -> -1, SV9(18) -1E-18 -> -1, S9PP -100 -> -100, -7/2 -> -4, -10/5 -> -2, 2 ** -1 * -1 -> -1, INTEGER(INTEGER(-1.5)/4) -> -1, ODO element EV(EC)=-0.5 -> -1. i5flt.cob (85 and 2023 identical): INTEGER(SIN(0)+999999999999999999) = 999999999999999999, INTEGER(COS(0)*1234567890123456.7)=1234567890123456, negative -> -1234567890123457: no binary64 precision loss beside a numeric function. INTEGER(1/3*3-1) = -1 follows the documented truncated-quotient technique (DOC-A.1-123, §1985 arithmetic-expression latitude), not INTEGER. cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.15.4 RV1.
